what_it_does: This accelerator speeds up AI language models (like GPT) running on edge devices or phones. It tackles three efficiency problems: first, autoregressive generation (where the model predicts one word at a time) requires re-reading massive weight matrices from memory for every token, creating a huge bandwidth bottleneck. Second, using mixed-precision math (storing weights as compact integers but activations as full-precision floats) normally requires expensive conversion overhead that kills the benefits of using integers. Third, the non-linear operations (softmax—a function that normalizes scores, and trig functions) steal 33% of processor time while waiting for results. The chip solves all three by compressing weights directly into the math units without conversion, rearranging computation to interleave matrix multiply and special function operations, and splitting data to minimize external memory reads.
